subject: BlueHarbor CAIQ: artifact sampler, owner roster and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@blueharborhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: BlueHarbor Security Team <security@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ mapping and sample artifacts request (BlueHarbor scope)

Marissa / Redwood security team,

Thanks for taking this on. BlueHarbor's external audit team has asked us to provide the CAIQ crosswalk and a small sampling of artifacts tied to high-risk controls (encryption keys, tenant isolation evidence, access logs for the last 90 days). To be concrete, we need:

- Completed CAIQ crosswalk (indicating control ownership and evidence path)
- A sample artifact bundle (logs, configuration snapshots, owner attestations) for 10 controls prioritized in the attached control list
- Short owner roster mapping controls -> owners with emails

Target date from our auditor: Nov 20. If you anticipate issues with the 90-day log export or need narrower scope (tenant vs whole-service), please propose alternatives and timeline.

Also: please include any DocuSign/attestation links you prefer we route through.

TIA,
Tina Lopez
Head of Information Risk | BlueHarbor Health
security@blueharborhealth.com

[Requested attachments: BlueHarbor_CSA_scope.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Security Team <security@blueharborhealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and sample artifacts request (BlueHarbor scope)

Hi Tina — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the auditor's request; below is our proposed delivery plan and a couple clarifying questions.

Proposed delivery (split by artifact type):
- CAIQ crosswalk: attach 'caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx' (will mark owner, evidence path, and expected artifact file name). ETA: Nov 12
- Artifact sample bundle: we will produce an initial artifact_manifest.csv listing artifacts and a zipped sample with 10 control artifacts. ETA for sampler upload: Nov 17
- Owner roster: attach 'owner_roster.md' with emails and escalation contacts. ETA: Nov 12

Clarifying scope/questions:
1) Scope: Do you want tenant-level sampling only (we'll restrict logs to BlueHarbor tenant) or full-service samples? Tenant-level is preferable for speed and privacy.
2) Logs: For runtime request logs and audit trails we can provide 90-day exports but the file will be large; would a narrower window (30 days) be acceptable for the initial review?
3) KMS attestation: will the auditor accept a KMS control statement + key residency screenshot, or do you need HSM certs?

Attachments: caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (work-in-progress), artifact_manifest.csv (template), owner_roster.md

If that plan looks good I'll assign owners and confirm upload location (share link) and DocuSign flow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
[attachment stubs: caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), artifact_manifest.csv (csv), owner_roster.md (markdown)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: BlueHarbor Security Team <security@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and sample artifacts request (BlueHarbor scope)

Marissa / team — assigning internal owners and ETA. Quoting Tina's original scope below for context.

Action items (internal):
- CAIQ crosswalk completion (kimberly_park): finalize answers and evidence paths in caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx. ETA Nov 12 EOD.
- Logs export (jonas_weber): generate tenant-filtered 90-day audit trail + S3 upload. If file >2GB, split into weekly chunks. ETA Nov 16.
- KMS/key residency screenshots (infra-ops via infra-ticket #INC-6291): provide screenshot + short statement. ETA Nov 15.
- Artifact sampler zip creation (marissa_cole): collect the 10 artifacts listed in artifact_manifest.csv, scrub PII where applicable, and upload to shared Drive. ETA Nov 17.

A couple of constraints to call out:
- For tenant-level log exports we need BlueHarbor tenant ID (please confirm scope below) — otherwise we'll prepare full-service exports which need additional approvals.
- DocuSign: let's use the standard security attestation template (I uploaded a copy to the drive link in my note).

Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping and sample artifacts request (BlueHarbor scope)

Marissa, Kimberly — this looks good, thank you. Confirming scope: tenant-level samples only (BlueHarbor tenant ID BH-449). 30-day log window is acceptable for the initial bundle; auditor will request 90-day if they need it later.

Please proceed with the timeline you outlined. We also need a short KMS attestation (template attached) indicating key storage region and whether keys are customer-managed. I'll route the DocuSign to the marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com address — the auditor needs the signed attestation by Nov 23.

Two small asks before upload:
- Can you include a README in the zip describing each artifact and any redactions performed?
- Please put the crosswalk status column (Draft/Final) in the spreadsheet so we can track what to expect.

Thanks again — Tina
Tina Lopez
